question: Has gap G001 already been addressed: No retrieved study isolates the effect of training-time context-enriched supervision from the effect of inference-time context construction in multi-hop KGQA. Every analyzed context-construction system operates at inference (SG-RAG MOT prompts a frozen LLM; CLAUSE adapts 'without retraining'; Co-E is training-free), while a training-free system is reported competitive with trained ones. Whether internalizing context during fine-tuning adds anything beyond supplying context at test time is therefore untested.?
rationale: A gap is only a hypothesis until a targeted search fails to find work that closes it.
